title: Sustainable Bioresource Systems Engineering

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

• Minimum Course Requirements: CHEM 142, CHEM 152, CHEM 162 (or CHEM 143, CHEM 153; or CHEM 145, CHEM 155, CHEM 165); MATH 124, MATH 125, MATH 126 (or MATH 134, MATH 135, MATH 136); PHYS 121 (or PHYS 141); 5 credits of English composition.

• Minimum grade requirements: Minimum 2.0 grade for each course required for admission; minimum 2.50 cumulative GPA in courses required for admission

• See department website for instructions to declare the sustainable bioresource systems engineering major

sections.credentialOverview:
Credential Overview

The Sustainable Bioresource Systems Engineering (SBSE) major combines process engineering, materials science, and sustainability fundamentals to provide students with a versatile foundation to engineer sustainable bio-based systems. Students in the major study bio-based processes and products by applying sustainability metrics and process engineering fundamentals. Graduates of the major find employment opportunities with industry, consulting firms, NGOs, and government agencies.
sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

General Education Requirements 

Basic Skills

• Written and Oral Communication (15 cr)

• English Composition: 5 credits from the University list (ENGL 131 preferred)

• Writing: 10 credits met by coursework in the major.

• Reasoning (RSN) (10 credits): met by program requirements

• Diversity (DIV) (5 credits): courses may also apply to an Areas of Inquiry requirement. Of Special Note: For students admitted to the University prior to autumn quarter 2023, the DIV requirement is 3 credits.

Areas of Inquiry

• Arts and Humanities (A&H) (10 credits): chosen from the University A&H list

• Social Sciences (SSc) (20 credits): 10 credits chosen from the University SSc list (outside the major); 10 credits met by coursework in the major

• Natural Sciences (NSc) (68-81 credits) 

• Mathematics (15-23 credits): complete one of the following: 

• MATH 124, MATH 125, MATH 126, MATH 207 (or AMATH 351), MATH 208 (or AMATH 352)

• MATH 134, MATH 135, MATH 136

• Sciences (30-33 credits): 

• CHEM 142, CHEM 152, CHEM 162 (or CHEM 143, CHEM 153; or CHEM 145, CHEM 155, CHEM 165), CHEM 237 (or CHEM 223 or CHEM 257)

• PHYS 121, PHYS 122 (or PHYS 141, PHYS 142)

• A A 260

• Statistics (3-5 credits): one of Q SCI 381, IND E 315, or STAT 390

• Additional NSc credits (20 credits): 10 credits chosen from the University NSc list (outside the major); 10 credits met by coursework in the major

Major Requirements

74-77 credits

• Sustainable Bioresource Systems Engineering (67 credits): ESRM 300/SBSE 300, SBSE 391, SBSE 392, SBSE 406, SBSE 410, SBSE 420, SBSE 422, SBSE 426, SBSE 430, SBSE 436, ESRM 461/SBSE 461, SBSE 475, SBSE 480, SBSE 481 

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA in SBSE courses applied to this requirement, with no grade below 1.0 in these courses

• Minimum 2.0 grade in SBSE 480 and SBSE 481

• Sustainable Bioresource Systems Engineering Electives (7-10 credits): One course taken from each of the categories below. Refer to department website for list of approved courses. 

• Computation and Data Science

• Business, Policy, and Economics

Additional electives as needed to reach 180 credits.
